lessons_used: adoption/redesign changes are helpful, with 3 winning tests showing positive impact (+7.1% average after noise correction).
sign_in/hint changes are helpful, with 2 winning tests showing positive impact (+2.9% average after noise correction), though 2 later tests showed no clear effect.
choose_path/copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests (-2.1% average after noise correction).
home/new_screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests (-0.8% average after noise correction).

Evidence is still thin for single-test categories (adoption/incentive, choose_path/layout, finish/new_flow, finish/new_screen, finish/notification, home/notification, home/wait_info) and sign_in/reorder where tests did not agree.
Predictions were overstated for weak ideas and early rounds, but significantly underestimated major winners in adoption/redesign and sign_in/hint.

decisions.title: Desktop Companion Activation Headline Copy Update
decisions.outcome: lost: did not hold up in re-test

lessons_next: adoption/redesign changes are helpful, with 3 winning tests showing strong positive impact (+6.9% average after noise correction).
sign_in/hint changes are helpful (+2.5% average after noise correction), backed by 2 winning tests, though recent tests showed no clear effect.
sign_in/reorder changes failed to improve onboarding, showing negative or no clear effect (-4.3% average after noise correction across 2 tests).
choose_path/copy, home/new_screen, home/wait_info, and choose_path/layout changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence is still thin for single-test categories (adoption/incentive, finish/copy, finish/new_flow, finish/new_screen, finish/notification, home/notification).
Predictions consistently overstated weak or unsuccessful ideas while underestimating major winning redesigns.
